title: The City of God, Volume I
author: Saint Augustine

waypoints.name: Rome
waypoints.notes: Rome is the historical crisis point addressed by the opening books.

waypoints.name: Hippo Regius
waypoints.notes: Augustine served as bishop of Hippo Regius in North Africa.

paths.title: Stationary authorial context at Hippo
paths.notes: The City of God is not a travel narrative. Rome is retained as the historical subject of the opening argument, while the mapped route remains stationary at Augustine's Hippo Regius authorial context.

sourceRefs.label: Sack of Rome and Augustine's apologetic frame
